import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,base64,re,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
def w(n,s):
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
prov=json.loads((p/'literal-provenance.json').read_text());res=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());r=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text());assert set(prov)==set(res)==set(map(str,r['ids']))
for k,v in prov.items():
 b=(p/('originals/'+k+'.jsonl')).read_bytes();assert b==base64.b64decode(v['raw_base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==v['raw_sha256'];assert b.endswith(b'\n')
 token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',b).group(1);assert token.decode()==v['statement_token'];assert hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest()==v['statement_token_sha256'];s=json.loads(token);assert s==v['statement'];assert hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()==v['statement_sha256']
ledger=(p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True);prev='0'*64;events=[]
for i,b in enumerate(ledger):
 x=json.loads(b);assert x['seq']==i and x['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();events.append(x)
charges=[json.loads(b) for b in (p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];budget=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==2;assert budget['queries_used']==sum(len(c['queries']) for c in charges)==6
for c in charges:assert hashlib.sha256((p/c['plan']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c['plan_sha256']
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 x=json.loads(f.read_text());assert x['exit']==0 and x['killed'] is None
 receipts.append({'path':f.name,'exit':x['exit'],'wall_s':x['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':x['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'samples':x['samples'],'affinity':x['affinity'],'cpu_limit_s':x['cpu_limit_s'],'as_limit_bytes':x['as_limit_bytes'],'deadline_s':x['deadline_s']})
audit={'exact_originals':20,'token_decoded_hashes_checked':20,'reservation_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'guard_attempts':sum(x['event']=='attempt' for x in events),'guard_successes':sum(x['event']=='success' for x in events),'guard_unavailable':sum(x['event']=='unavailable' for x in events),'guard_chain_tip':prev,'search_calls':2,'search_queries':6,'source_originals_read':5,'originals_unread':15,'other_primary_pdfs':2,'native_tool_cpu_rss':'unavailable','sampling_limit':'transient and separate writer peaks unavailable','completed_receipts':receipts,'own_audit_receipt':'final_documentary_audit.receipt.json produced on return; included in terminal manifest','mathematical_validation':'NOT_INDEPENDENT; provenance and bookkeeping only'}
w('documentary-audit.json',json.dumps(audit,indent=2));print({k:v for k,v in audit.items() if k!='completed_receipts'})
print('SUMSET VERSION HEADER', (p/'sources/sumsets.txt').read_text()[:900])
